clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers travelers a burst of speed drawn from Agamaggan's blood shards. The captive quilboar's ritual helps them cross the Barrens swiftly.

Crossing the Barrens quickly can help you avoid its beasts and centaur warbands. At Camp Taurajo, the captive quilboar Mangletooth draws on red crystalline blood shards scattered across the region. Give him ten, and he channels their lingering power into a burst of swiftness called the Spirit of the Wind.

Quilboar honor Agamaggan, the Great Boar whose blood was spilled across central Kalimdor during the ancient War of the Ancients. Mangletooth knows the rites that channel that spilled blood, even in captivity. The ritual stirs wild vigor, lending a runner speed to match the zhevra herds. Though quilboar are bitter enemies of the Horde, Mangletooth shares Agamaggan's boons with travelers who bring him fresh shards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.
It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, traveler. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.
